name: Fish tacos
intro: San Diego's taco, made with this month's fish. Seared, not fried, and finished in the time it takes to warm the tortillas.

variations.context: The default. Salted yogurt and pomegranate. The pomegranate is the salsa.
Chile-garlic oil over the fish, lime squeezed hard, arugula.
Smear ajvar on the warm tortilla first, fish on top, feta last.

finish: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they blister in spots, and stack them under a towel. Two per taco. Sear the fish the same way as the weekend — dry, hot pan, hands off — then flake it straight into the tortillas.
